A2.1 • ENTERTAINMENT AND FREE TIME • LESSON 2 OF 6

What should we watch?

Suggest, respond and find a choice that works for everyone.

Make suggestions.
Accept or refuse politely.
Offer an alternative.
Build a choice dialogue.
1

5 min

B • Shadow Streetthrillermysterious • tense • rainy

D • Little Orbitanimated adventurefamily-friendly • warm • fun

2

Suggestion toolkit

Notice the form after each suggestion starter.

9 min
PatternExampleUse
Let’s + base verbLet’s watch a comedy.direct, friendly
Why don’t we + base verb?Why don’t we watch this one?friendly idea
How about + -ing?How about watching a thriller?open suggestion
Shall we + base verb?Shall we go to the movies?correct; less common in casual AmE
Do you want to + base verb?Do you want to watch a series?invitation / preference check
American English note
Shall we…? is understood and useful. In relaxed everyday American English, Let’s…, How about…?, Why don’t we…? and Do you want to…? are generally more frequent.
